name: default
about: The shipped starting map (first written by scripts/seed_worldmap.py, repainted since). Edit it on the tuner's Environment > World map page. Tier A: seed-independent.

terrain.about: The terrain, per MAP: the seeded NOISE on the authored height plane (map v2). Lengths in voxels at refVoxelsPerMetre; log2 cells are shifts; fbmAtten / sedFraction / sedSlope are Q8 counts. The ground is planes.height (absolute voxels) + range/hill/detail/grain (the seeded octave ladder; the biome curve shapes the range rung); homeArea is the calm noise around the spawn site; the sediment wedge and the treeline are what they were as knobs. baseHeight is the height used only when no plane is loaded. Per-biome relief is each biome file's `terrain` block.

sites.about: Where the game starts, and the centre of the calm home area (terrain.homeArea). Must be on land and off any lake: the spawn-site gate checks all of that. In the wood south of Harrowby, so a new game wakes among trees with the village ahead (north); it was (580, 3515), on the green's edge, until 2026-09-29.

Harrowby's ground (docs/EDITOR_GUIDE.md section 14): inside this box the biome's own rolling relief is kept at a fraction of its swells (hills) and 3 m bumps (bumps), with no sub-metre grain and the tracks between the doors flatter still (paths), easing back to the untouched forest floor across the feather. No clearing: the forest stands among the houses, and every tree whose crown would come within 1 m of a building is left out (the per-tree building rule); the houses level their own floors and doorsteps and ease into this ground over their ramps (refs/harrowby.json padMargin / padApron).
An AUTHORED lake (P-F): same place on every seed, the spawn_lake preset's geometry. Placed on the map, not relative to the spawn; the spawn-site gate checks the spawn stays off it.
